business_summary.text: Cipla reported Q2FY27 results with a 2% YoY decline in revenue to ₹7,404 Cr and EBITDA margin contraction to 18.7%. The company maintained its FY27 EBITDA margin guidance of 18.5-20% and achieved key milestones with the US FDA approval for gAdvair Diskus and a strategic partnership for a Keytruda biosimilar. The US respiratory business showed strength with gProventil ranking No. 1 in the market, and South Africa's private market grew 1.3x faster than the market.

call_points.text: FY27 EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 18.5-20%.
gProventil ranked No. 1 in the US Albuterol MDI market with 22% share.
Material cost increased to ₹2,634 Cr in Q2FY27 from ₹2,498 Cr in Q2FY26.
Cash and Cash Equivalents stood at ₹10,522 Cr as of Sep-2026.
FY27 EBITDA margins are guided at 18.5% to 20% with second-half weighting due to new product launches.
North America aims for a $1 billion exit run rate by the end of FY27, backed by new respiratory approvals.
Total cash and cash equivalents stood at ₹11,140 Cr as of March 2026.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Disallowances of expenses u/s. 37(1) of the Income Tax Act from AY 2010-11 to AY 2022-23 (excluding AY 2011-12). Forums where matters are pending: Hon'ble High Court of Bombay, ITAT and CIT(A). Quantum of claim (Disputed tax value): INR 308 crores
tax_litigation.status: The Company has received an order for AY 2023-24 (FY 2022-23) from the Office of the Joint Commissioner of Income Tax in respect of one of matter pertaining to Section 37(1). The Company has preferred an appeal before Hon’ble CIT(A) against the alleged order. Pursuant to the said order, the aggregate quantum of claim (Disputed tax value) for disallowances of expenses u/s 37(1) from AY 2010-11 to AY 2023-24 (excluding AY 2011-12) stands at INR 366 crores. Accordingly, all the matters related to disallowances of expenses u/s. 37(1) of the Income Tax Act from AY 2010-11 to AY 2023-24 (excluding AY 2011-12) continue to remain pending for disposal at Hon'ble Bombay High Court / ITAT Mumbai & CIT(A).

Cipla announced board outcomes including the 90th AGM date for June 25, 2026, the appointment of Sushrut Kulkarni as Global Chief – IPD, cost auditor appointment, and stock option grants.
